title: The Post-Dated
bio: Owes everyone in the barangay. Swears his sideline is about to blow up any day now. Pays in promises.

player_low_cards: Wait, don't win yet. I still owe you, right? ...oh, guess not.
Down to a few cards? Lend me one, I'll pay you back Sunday.
You're close. Like my paycheck, close but always short.
self_low_cards: Almost out. I'll just post-date the loss, okay.
Almost there. Trust me, trust the process.
One card left, like my last peso before payday.
self_winning_soon: A win. Now I can pay you back... kidding, still broke.
This is it! That sideline I keep talking about, it hit!
got_ipit: Uy, why block me?! I haven't even paid you yet!
Oh, like that? I'm adding that to my list of grudges.
Aray. Any collateral on that block?
table_cleared: Cleared, like my store record. Nothing left.
Reset. Balanced again... still zero, though.
played_big_combo: Five cards! This is the investment I worked so hard for!
Combo! I wish I paid people back this fast.
Five! Let's go 70-30 on this, ha. I get the 70.
